verdicts.quote: If any row is invalid, no user is created from that file
Every invalid row is reported with its row number, its column and its reason
A row whose email already belongs to an existing user is invalid ... the existing user is unchanged. / A row whose email repeats an earlier row in the same file is invalid
Any admin may assign any existing role, including `admin`, in a row ... only admins reach the import and admins can already create admins one at a time
An upload request from a signed-in non-admin is refused ... receives HTTP 403; 0 users are created and no invitation is sent.
A file with no `email` column is rejected whole / A file with a column that is not `email`, `name` or `role` is rejected whole / a file with an unrecognised or missing header
comma-separated, double-quote quoting, line breaks CRLF or LF ... A leading UTF-8 byte-order mark is ignored ... A quoted name containing a line break is reported
The invitation emails are sent after the result is shown ... A rejected or failed import sends no email and creates no password link
A file with 1,001 data rows is rejected whole with a message that states the limit of 1,000 ... A file larger than 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes) is rejected
A 0-byte file, a file with only the header row, and a file with a header and only blank lines are each rejected ... (for that file with 1 data row: 1)
Submitting the same 3-row file a second time after it succeeded reports each of the 3 rows as already existing ... no second invitation is sent
the import is done inside one web request ... The result of a 1,000-row valid file is shown within 30 seconds
Every invitation of a successful import is delivered or recorded as failed within 1 hour ... mail providers limit sending rates (exact figure unconfirmed)
verdicts.missing: The actual sending rate or pacing of the invitations (whether all go at once or are throttled, and at what rate).

verdicts.quote: A user created by import cannot sign in until the person has chosen a password ... Users created by import are active ... They open the link, choose a password, and sign in.
The uploaded file is not kept after the request, and its contents are not written to logs
the operator can read a record with the admin's identity, the time, the number of data rows, the number of users created ... and the outcome
The admin closes the browser tab 1 second after pressing submit ... all-or-nothing makes a corrected re-upload safe
verdicts.missing: Whether there is any deliberate way to cancel a running import; retry is only by re-uploading the whole corrected file, with no retry-failed-rows behaviour stated.

verdicts.quote: from pressing submit with 1,000 valid rows to seeing the result takes no more than 30 seconds ... a progress indication appears
The single-user form creates a user with the same fields, the same checks and the same result as before ... An import never changes any user who existed before it
A name is stored as given after trimming, even when it begins with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` ... A name longer than 200 characters is invalid
